preconditions.description: The length of word s must be between 1 and 100 characters.
The length of word t must be between 1 and 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Word s must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Word t must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if s == t[::-1] else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: If t is the reverse of s, output 'YES'; otherwise, output 'NO'.
